articles.title: Cast your vote for BBC Women's Footballer of the Year 2026
articles.summary: Voting is now open for the BBC Women's Footballer of the Year 2026, with five players on the shortlist.

articles.title: Dortmund fans' group criticises Nmecha celebration
articles.summary: A Christian group set up for footballers says it wants to "demonstrate love and respect towards everyone" following criticism from fans.

articles.title: Kane and Bellingham air strong views in England World Cup review
articles.summary: England players are understood to have aired strong views about their World Cup semi-final defeat by Argentina in a team meeting.

articles.title: No further F1 engine upgrades handed out after final 2026 review period
articles.summary: No further engine upgrade opportunities have been granted to Formula 1's power unit manufacturers following the third and final review period of the 2026 season, the FIA has confirmed.

articles.title: England Wheelchair rout Australia to reach World Cup final
articles.summary: England Wheelchair scored a record points total against rival Australia to rout their opponents 86-18 and reach their fifth successive Rugby League World Cup final.
